parameters.title: Cell Set / Analysis Universe
parameters.description: Restricts the cells considered by an op. This is a biological and computational universe choice, not a cosmetic filter.
guidance: Use a biologically justified set for focused analysis.
Use all/core intentionally; changing the set can change effect sizes, trajectory curves, and enrichment.

parameters.title: Matrix Input
parameters.description: Symbolic matrix primitive consumed by an op. The matrix defines the feature universe and measurement scale.
guidance: Choose RNA/ATAC/counts/normalized matrix intentionally.
Matrix semantics are more important than the string id; future matrix metadata should formalize this.

parameters.title: Embedding / Latent Space Input
parameters.description: Symbolic space primitive used for geometry, clustering, nearest-neighbor, projection, or trajectory operations.
guidance: Use a space whose dimensions represent the biology under study.
Changing space can change distances, branches, and inferred progress.

parameters.title: Model Reference Input
parameters.description: Reference to a fitted model or trajectory object used by downstream projection/smoothing/dynamics ops.
guidance: Model provenance defines the biological orientation and branch structure.
Do not treat models from different methods as interchangeable without checking semantics.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Vector Input
parameters.description: Continuous per-cell progress coordinate, usually inferred by a trajectory method or path-scoring op.
guidance: Pseudotime is relative to its root/orientation.
Compare methods only after aligning orientation and intersecting cells when needed.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Direction
parameters.description: Controls whether pseudotime is used as provided or inverted before binning, curve metrics, and class assignment.
guidance: Set this so early and late correspond to the biological start and endpoint.
Inversion changes interpretation, not the underlying cell scores.

parameters.title: Biological Start Label
parameters.description: Human-readable label for the intended biological start of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
guidance: Use this to make orientation explicit in reports.
This records intent; it does not root the trajectory by itself.

parameters.title: Biological End Label
parameters.description: Human-readable label for the intended biological endpoint of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
guidance: Use this to make endpoint interpretation explicit.
This records intent; it does not alter model geometry by itself.

parameters.title: Lineage Subset
parameters.description: Restricts analysis to one or more lineage/path keys from a trajectory, relation, or path family.
guidance: Use lineage keys that are present in the upstream model/artifact.
Different methods may use different lineage/branch key semantics.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Scoring Method
parameters.description: Defines how member features are collapsed into a per-cell or per-bin feature-set score.
guidance: Mean/sum depend on expression scale and set size.
Rank-based methods reduce scale sensitivity but change interpretation.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Namespace
parameters.description: Selects the registered collection of feature sets to screen or score.
guidance: Treat namespace as the biological hypothesis library.
Report the namespace because it defines what could have been discovered.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Subset
parameters.description: Optional restriction to named feature sets within a namespace.
guidance: Use NULL for broad discovery.
Use explicit subsets for targeted validation.

parameters.title: Signal Key Subset
parameters.description: Optional restriction to selected keys in a cell_vector_family, such as UCell signatures or chromVAR motifs.
guidance: Use NULL for broad signal-family screening.
Use explicit keys for targeted follow-up.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Bin Count
parameters.description: Number of bins used to aggregate cells along pseudotime before curve summaries and dynamics metrics.
guidance: More bins preserve detail but increase sparsity/noise.
Fewer bins smooth curves but may hide sharp transitions.

parameters.title: Minimum Cells Per Bin
parameters.description: Minimum number of cells required for a pseudotime bin to be retained.
guidance: Higher values make curves more stable but can remove sparse terminal regions.
Report this when interpreting missing or truncated curves.

parameters.title: Bin Summary Function
parameters.description: Statistic used to summarize cell-level values within each bin.
guidance: Mean is sensitive to outliers and abundance shifts.
Median is more robust but may compress sparse expression.

parameters.title: Minimum Curve Amplitude Filter
parameters.description: Minimum observed/smoothed curve range required for a signal or feature set to pass report filters.
guidance: This is a reporting/filter threshold, not a p-value.
Set it relative to score scale; amplitude units differ between mean expression, UCell, chromVAR, and ranks.

parameters.title: Minimum Amplitude For Non-Flat Class
parameters.description: Minimum curve range required before assigning a non-flat dynamic class.
guidance: Use this to avoid classifying tiny numerical wiggles as biology.
Keep distinct from min_amplitude if you want permissive reporting but conservative classes.

parameters.title: Minimum Observed Bins Filter
parameters.description: Minimum number of retained pseudotime bins required for a curve to pass filters.
guidance: Higher values reduce fragmentary curves.
Sparse branches may fail this filter even if biologically interesting.

parameters.title: Minimum Detected Set Members
parameters.description: Minimum number of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
guidance: Use this to avoid interpreting gene sets represented by too few measured genes.
Important for targeted panels and cross-species or sparse feature spaces.

parameters.title: Minimum Detected Set Fraction
parameters.description: Minimum fraction of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
guidance: Complements min_features_detected by scaling with set size.
Useful when screening gene sets of very different sizes.

parameters.title: On/Off Delta Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum late-minus-early absolute difference required for turns_on or turns_off classes.
guidance: Interpret relative to score scale.
A stricter threshold reduces weak monotonic calls.

parameters.title: Monotonicity Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum absolute Spearman correlation with pseudotime required for monotonic on/off classes.
guidance: Higher values require cleaner monotonic behavior.
Transient or multi-phase curves should not be forced into monotonic classes.

parameters.title: Curve Smoothing Method
parameters.description: Optional smoother applied to binned curves before metrics and class assignment.
guidance: Smoothing can reveal broad dynamics but can also erase sharp transitions.
Report the method because it affects classes.

parameters.title: LOESS Span
parameters.description: Controls the locality of LOESS smoothing when smooth_method is loess.
guidance: Smaller span follows local variation more closely.
Larger span produces broader, smoother trends.

parameters.title: Bootstrap Replicate Count
parameters.description: Number of bootstrap resamples per bin for confidence intervals; zero disables bootstrap intervals.
guidance: Use for report-quality uncertainty bands.
Large values increase runtime.

parameters.title: Confidence Interval Level
parameters.description: Nominal confidence level for bootstrap confidence bands.
guidance: Higher levels produce wider intervals.
Only meaningful when bootstrap_n is greater than zero.

parameters.title: MAD Distance Inclusion Multiplier
parameters.description: Threshold multiplier for median absolute deviation distance filters around a trajectory/path.
guidance: Lower values create a tighter trajectory tube and exclude more distant cells.
Interpret relative to the embedding/space; unlike fixed distance thresholds, MAD adapts to scale.
Not yet universal in op interfaces; include when route inclusion becomes a first-class op parameter.

parameters.title: Top-N Retention
parameters.description: Number of top-ranked records retained for compact outputs or reports.
guidance: Does not usually change the full underlying calculation unless explicitly documented.
Use larger values for exploratory reports.

parameters.title: Random Seed
parameters.description: Seed used for stochastic algorithms or resampling.
guidance: Set explicitly for replayable reports.
Changing seed can affect stochastic fits, bootstraps, or approximations.
